text_block_list.text:
With the Japan Dirt Derby behind her,
Smart Falcon focuses her attention on
summer camp.
Her passion is
extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hnnngh! ☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Th-that's fifty... sets of sprints... done!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff... Wheeze...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huff... It's okay! I can... keep going!
choice_data_list: Want to take a break soon?
Want to take a break soon?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There are going to be older students
racing at the
JBC Classic coming up!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That means I have to get even stronger
during
summer camp! So, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I can keep going! Make me into a top
Umadol!

She's been overexerting herself, though.
I need
something she can enjoy without
putting too
much stress on her body...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A dance lesson! Like special Umadol
training,
right?
choice_data_list: Core Strength! Dance Lessons on th...
Patience! Dance lessons at the tra...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: All right! Let's dance!
choice_data_list: Let's strengthen your core on the ...

text_block_list.text:
Smart Falcon dances her heart out on
the sand, her intense concentration
captivating all those
who lay eyes upon
her, until...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Aahhhh...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
My... my legs are spent... I don't think I
can move
them another inch...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hold on, Trainer! I'm okay!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
There's no way I can stop now... I can't
allow my
feet to fail me now...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Get up, feet! Get up! And then...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Soar! Soar like a swan!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...W-was I flying just now?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What are they doing? Some kind of
musical?

We may have gotten carried away, but
in the end,
Smart Falcon still enjoys a
fun training session.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
A dance lesson! Like special Umadol
training,
right?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: But what do you mean by "self-control"?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Trainer! You're such a meanie!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Why, you! You can't just have ramen
right in front
of my face like this!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Gulp! I-I want some too! Just a bite...
choice_data_list: The deep seafood flavor is delicious!
The rich seafood flavor is so deli...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Uggghhh! You're a monster!
choice_data_list: After we dance through one whole s...
After we dance through one whole s...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
What's going on over there? Some kind
of new
game?

...After Smart Falcon manages to finish a
concert's worth of dancing, I treat her to
a bowl of special
seafood ramen topped
with clams.
